newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil IGP-M price index unchanged June 21-July 10.
newsitem.headline: Brazil IGP-M price index unchanged June 21-July 10.

text.p: Brazilian IGP-M inflation index showed no change between June 21 and July 10, compared with a 0.69 percent rise between May 21 and June 10, the Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) said on Thursday.

The IGP-M is composed of three other economic indicators: the IPA wholesale price index, which dropped 0.50 percent in the latest period; the IPC consumer price index, which advanced 0.51 percent; and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.91 percent.
The IPA has a 60 percent weighting, the IPC a 30 percent weighting and the INCC 10 percent, the FGV said.
The IGP-M index, which measures inflation over 10-day intervals is published by the independent research institute Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV).
